title: The boundary of the unit section is the extension class
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal E\to\mathcal O_X\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with Yoneda class $e\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal A)$. Under the canonical identification from [lem-sc-ext-locally-free], $\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal A)=H^1(X,\mathcal A)$, the connecting homomorphism $H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)\to H^1(X,\mathcal A)$ sends $1$ to $e$.

source.place: Cohomology Lemma Tag 0B3A (first cohomology and extensions: the extension class is the image of 1 under the boundary)

proof.text: Take $\mathcal F=\mathcal O_X$ in [lem-sc-ext-locally-free], so $\mathcal F^\vee\otimes\mathcal G=\mathcal G$. By [def-sc-ext-sheaf] and [pqf-def-cohomology], $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal O_X,-)$ and $H^i(X,-)$ are the right derived functors of the left exact functors $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal O_X,-)$ and $\Gamma(X,-)$, which are identified by $s\mapsto s(1)$; both are universal $\delta$-functors by [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor], so the canonical identification $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal O_X,-)=H^i(X,-)$, the unique morphism of $\delta$-functors extending this degree-zero identification, commutes with connecting maps. Hence the cohomology connecting map $H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)\to H^1(X,\mathcal A)$ of $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal E\to\mathcal O_X\to0$ is the Ext connecting map $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal A)$ of [def-sc-ext-sheaf], and $1\in H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)$ corresponds to $\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal O_X}$.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma Tag 05TE (derived functors form a universal delta-functor); Cohomology Lemma Tag 0B3A (Ext^1(O_X,F) and H^1(X,F))

proof.text: By [lem-sc-p1-ext-connecting-yoneda] with $\mathcal F=\mathcal O_X$ and $s=\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal O_X}$, the Ext connecting map sends $\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal O_X}$ to $e\circ\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal O_X}$, which is $\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal O_X},\mathcal A)(e)=e$ by [lem-sc-p1-ext-yoneda-functoriality]. With Step 1, the cohomology connecting map sends $1$ to $e$.
